item.title: An intrusive origin for the Nili Fossae regional olivine-bearing unit
item.content:encoded:
Communications Earth & Environment, Published online: 11 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43247-026-04086-7

Nili Fossae’s olivine-rich unit is part of a giant dike-and-sill complex, reconciling orbital and rover observations, according to new mapping of geological features in the Nili Fossae region on Mars.
